 3D boys belt is genuine brown leather billets that are embossed with feathers and a scrolling pattern. The body of the belt is brown with white buck lace stitching along the sides. There is a resin beaded cross inlay in blue black and white. Complimented with an antique silver buckle with gold cross motifs in the corner and a rope edge. Engraving and a bull rider motif in the center.
